issues.description: Meal constructor parameter order differs between the problem statement/UML and the provided template code. The UML specifies `Meal(String name, String[] ingredients)`, and the solution implements `public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients)`. However, the template defines `public Meal(String[] ingredients, String name)`, reversing the parameter order. This causes compilation errors or confusion when students instantiate `Meal` following the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template constructor signature to `public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients)` to match the UML/specification and solution. Update any template usages accordingly.
